evidence.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark

summary: Researchers found that enabling two specific settings significantly boosted AI scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, demonstrating how minor adjustments can yield major gains. The discovery highlights the importance of fine-tuning in AI model optimization.
title: Simple Configuration Tweaks Triple AI Performance on ARC-AGI-3 Benchmark
